reasons.unavailable: The machine holding these files cannot be reached right now.
reasons.read_only: This tree is read-only for you.
reasons.one_at_a_time: This works on one entry at a time.
reasons.folder_nothing_to_edit: A folder has nothing to edit. Open it instead.
reasons.symlink_edit: This is a link. The panel reports links and never follows them, so open what it points at directly.
reasons.file_too_large_to_open: This file is larger than the panel will open. Download it instead.
reasons.folder_cannot_download: A folder cannot be downloaded as it is. Compress it first, then take the archive.
reasons.symlink_download: This is a link, and following it could leave this tree. Download what it points at instead.
reasons.not_an_archive: That is not an archive this panel can unpack.
reasons.measure_one: This measures one folder at a time.
reasons.file_shows_size: A file already shows its size in the list.

page.title: Files
page.page_desc: {root}, on the machine holding {service}. There is no SFTP: this is the way in.
page.upload_refusal_unavailable: Uploading is off while this tree cannot be reached.
page.upload_refusal_readonly: You have read access to this organization, so uploading is off.
page.upload_refusal_static_site: This is a static site's releases tree. Its files come from the last build, and anything written here would be replaced by the next deployment.
page.error_title: These files cannot be listed right now
page.read_only_note: This tree is read-only for you, so the operations that would change it are switched off.
page.show_dotfiles_hint: Hidden by default: what a customer came to see is their own files, and this is one tap.
page.folder_dropped_error: {names} {verb} a folder. Compress it first, upload the archive, then use Extract on it - that keeps the structure and survives a dropped connection, which a folder of loose files would not.
page.load_more_error: The rest of this folder did not arrive. The node may have gone away.
page.delete_confirm_body: Folders are deleted with everything inside them. Nothing here goes to a bin.
page.symlink_notice: {name} is a link. The panel reports links and never follows them, so open what it points at directly.
page.too_large_notice: {name} is too large to open here. Downloading it instead.

list.empty_desc_all: Nothing here at all, including dotfiles. Upload something, or create a folder to put it in.
list.empty_desc_hidden: Nothing here, though dotfiles are hidden - turn them on if you are looking for one. Otherwise, upload a file or create a folder.
list.load_error_title: The rest of this folder did not arrive
list.sorted_note: · sorted within what has loaded so far

path.up_button_top: This is the top of the tree.

editor.revert_title_dirty: Put the file back to what was read
editor.save_title_readonly: This file is open for reading only.
editor.truncated_banner: This file is larger than the panel will open, so you are looking at the beginning of it. Saving is off: writing this buffer back would replace the whole file with the part that was read.
editor.binary_banner: This does not decode as text, so it is shown as far as it can be and saving is off - writing it back would replace every byte the decoder could not represent. Download it if you need the real contents.
editor.readonly_banner: This tree is read-only for you, so the file opens for reading. A static site's files come from its last build, and an edit here would be replaced by the next deployment.
editor.error_title: The file could not be opened
editor.loading_text: Reading the file from the node.
editor.default_read_error: The file could not be read. The node holding it may be unreachable.
editor.leave_confirm: This file has changes that have not been saved. Leave anyway?
editor.discard_confirm_body: The changes in this file have not been written to the volume.

upload.drop_or_pick: Drop files anywhere on the page, or pick them here.
upload.chunked_notice: Uploads are sent in chunks and carry on by themselves after a dropped connection - they resume from where they stopped rather than starting again.
upload.resumed_note: · carried on from where it stopped

drop.ready_desc: They go into {destination}, and carry on by themselves if the connection drops.

move.same_folder_error: That is the folder they are already in.
move.nothing_moved_error: Nothing was moved. The message above says what the panel refused.
move.partial_moved_error: {moved} of {count} moved. The rest were refused - the message above says why.
move.into_hint: Relative to the top of this tree. The folder has to exist already.
move.replace_hint: Off by default, so a move cannot quietly overwrite a file of the same name.
move.keeping_names: {count} entries, keeping the names they have now.

rename.title: Rename
rename.slash_error: A name cannot contain a slash. Use Move to put it in another folder.
rename.same_name_error: That is what it is already called.
rename.name_hint: Just the name. Renaming keeps it in this folder.
rename.overwrite_hint: Off by default. With this on, a file at the new name is overwritten and not recoverable.

new_folder.title: New folder
new_folder.description: It is created inside the folder you are looking at.
new_folder.name_hint: Letters, digits, dots, dashes. No slashes - this makes one folder.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.invalid_mode_error: Three or four octal digits, like 755.
permissions.mode_hint: Only owner, group and other read/write/execute are applied. setuid, setgid and the sticky bit are dropped.
permissions.recursive_hint: The node keeps directories enterable, so a recursive 644 does not lock you out of the tree.

measure.title: Folder size
measure.default_error: The node did not finish measuring this folder.
measure.walking: Walking the tree. A folder with a lot in it takes a few seconds.
measure.approximate_note: The node stopped at its walk budget, so the real total is larger than this. Measuring a smaller folder gives an exact answer.

archive.description: The node builds the archive; nothing is uploaded or downloaded to do it.
archive.path_hint: Relative to the top of this tree.
archive.summary_many: {count} entries from this folder, packed as they are named here.

extract.title: Unzip
extract.into_hint: Relative to the top of this tree. Leave it as it is to unpack here.
extract.overwrite_label: Replace files that are already there
extract.overwrite_hint: Off by default, so an archive cannot quietly overwrite work that is not in it.

page.not_placed_title: Nothing is running this service yet
page.not_placed_desc: A shell runs inside the container, so there has to be one. Start {name} and this page will open a shell in it - the platform places it on a node, pulls the image and reports back, which usually takes a few seconds.
page.readonly_title: You have read access to this organization
page.readonly_desc: A shell inside a container can do anything the application can, so opening one counts as changing things. Somebody with a developer role or above can open it, and logs and metrics are still available to you.
page.header_desc: /bin/sh inside the container. It ends by itself after {idle} idle, and after {max} whatever happens.
page.reconnecting_banner: The connection to the shell dropped and is being re-established. Anything typed in the meantime is held and sent when it comes back.
page.exit_banner: The shell ended with exit code {code}{reason}. Nothing in the container was stopped - only the shell.
page.no_shell_running: No shell is running. Opening this page does not start one - a terminal left open in a background tab is a process inside your container, so it is always something you ask for.

paste_dialog.title: Paste into the shell
paste_dialog.description: Your browser did not give the panel access to the clipboard, so paste it here instead.
paste_dialog.text_hint: Sent to the shell exactly as it is, including the line breaks.
